turn_log.text: The emergency sense wiring for H1 at W9A_TB15 to W9A_P9 has failed open so the control never sees acceptable emergency power. Step 8 proves this with an open reading while step 4 and step 6 both read 0.0 ohms and show the other paths are good. Step 2 also confirms the fault because the switch is still waiting for emergency acceptable. An authorized person should deenergize both sources and then inspect and tighten or repair the W9A_TB15 to W9A_P9 connection and retest for continuity.

Step 8 proves this with an open reading while step 4 and step 6 both read 0.0 ohms and show the other paths are good. attempts.problem: The transcription does not reproduce the documented fault-free sequence of the Group G controller: a healthy outage and retransfer gives ['N Source Not Accepted', 'Engine Start'], expected ['N Source Not Accepted', 'Engine Start', 'E Source Accepted', 'Transfer N to E', 'N Source Accepted', 'Transfer E to N', 'Engine Stop', 'E Source Not Accepted']. Simulating your transcription, after NR drops out (engine start signal) the engine start contact between TB/TS 14 and TB/TS 15 does not close, so the generator never starts. Check that circuit on the drawing: H1:W24_P17, H1:W24_TB16, H1:W8A_P8, H1:W8A_TB14, H1:W8B_TB14, H1:W8B_TS14, H1:W9A_P9, H1:W9A_TB15, H1:W9B_TB15, H1:W9B_TS15, NR:J17, NR:J8, NR:J9, TBTS:14, TBTS:15, TBTS:16, TS:14, TS:15, XP:J17, XP:J8, XP:J9, XP:P17, XP:P8, XP:P9.
attempts.explanation: Fixed NR engine-start contact common from J17 to J8: nc J9-J17 -> J9-J8, so dropout closes TB/TS-14 (P8/J8 net) to TB/TS-15 (P9/J9 net) for Feature 7 close-to-start and opens J8-J17 for Feature 8 open-to-start, per CP ENGINE START SIGNAL box.

attempts.problem: The transcription does not reproduce the documented fault-free sequence of the Group G controller: a healthy outage and retransfer gives ['N Source Not Accepted', 'Engine Start', 'E Source Accepted', 'Transfer Failure'], expected ['N Source Not Accepted', 'Engine Start', 'E Source Accepted', 'Transfer N to E', 'N Source Accepted', 'Transfer E to N', 'Engine Stop', 'E Source Not Accepted']. Simulating your transcription, Emergency is accepted and ER is energized but the switch does not transfer (voltage across the TS solenoid right after the command: 0.0 V). Check that circuit on the drawing: ER:J1, ER:J15, ER:J16, ER:J5, ER:X1, ER:X2, H1:W15_P15, H1:W15_TS70, H1:W16_P16, H1:W16_TS72, H1:W17_TS4, H1:W17_TS9, H1:W1_P1, H1:W1_TS8, H1:W21_TS5, H1:W21_TS71, H1:W2_P2, H1:W2_TSA, H1:W3_P3, H1:W3_TS6, H1:W5_P5, H1:W5_TSB, SE:J2, SE:J3, SE:J5, SE:X1, SE:X2, TS:6, TS:70, TS:71, TS:72, TS:8, TS:9, TS:A, TS:B, XP:J1, XP:J15, XP:J16, XP:J2, XP:J3, XP:J5, XP:P1, XP:P15, XP:P16, XP:P2, XP:P3, XP:P5.
attempts.explanation: Fixed TS operator circuit: moved normal-B J5-J15 from ER:false to SE:false, moved X2-J5 from SE:false to SE:nc, moved emergency-B J16-X2 from ER:nc to ER:false; so N-to-E with ER energized and SE de-energized closes J1-X1-X2-J2 and J16-X2-X5-J5 to power solenoid, and E-to-N with SE energized closes J2-J3 and J5-J15.
